c01260.credit: 黒布直導 笹 塔五郎

homophones.basis: The kanji differ, 佑実 against 祐美, which no transcription rule produces. What is on the other side is real: both credits are girls×garden comics books from ジーオーティー, and both sit in the Avalon anthology line, 須藤佑実 on four of its volumes and 須藤祐美 on AVALON. That is the shape of one artist mis-keyed at one source, and 須藤祐美’s reading is an analyser guess while 須藤佑実’s is one まんが王国 prints. It is still a claim about which characters the artist writes their name with, and no source we hold states that the two are one person. The pair is recorded as sharing a reading and a line, and it is the first one a source check should settle.

homophones.basis: アキラ is the whole of 日明’s reading, which would ordinarily settle it, and here it does not. アキラ is among the commonest given names in Japanese and stands as a complete pen name on its own; both credits reach us through 百合コレ, a self-publishing line carrying 496 works, so sharing it is not agreement about anything. Each credits one work and nothing else connects 夏の光と山の闇 to 自重して！南さん. Two artists read アキラ on one aggregator is the ordinary case, so the pair stays two credits and the relation is recorded instead.
